Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: And since the priests — the Levites, who are the rest of the tribe of Levi — shall have no portion nor inheritance with the house of Israel, it is from the offerings of God and from His inheritance that they shall eat.
translations.2: And an inheritance shall not be his among his brothers, for the prescribed dues of God are his inheritance, as He has decreed for him.
translations.3: And this is what shall be the customary due of the priests from the people: from whoever slaughters any slaughter — whether of cattle or of flocks — they shall give them the foreleg, and the two jaws, and the stomach.
translations.4: The first of your grain, your juice, and your oil, and the first of the shearing of your flock — you shall give him.
translations.5: For God your Lord has chosen him from all your tribes, to stand and to serve in the name of God — he and his sons for the length of time.
translations.6: And when any Levite makes pilgrimage from some of your settlements belonging to all the house of Israel, in which he is residing, he may enter at whatever time he wishes, to the place which God shall choose.
translations.7: And he shall serve in the name of God his Lord, like all his Levite brothers who stand there before God.
translations.8: And they shall share equal portions — save for what the forefathers established from the rotations.
translations.9: And know that you are entering the land which God your Lord is giving you: do not learn to do after the manner of the abominations of those nations.
translations.10: Let there not be found among you one who burns his son or his daughter in the fire, nor a diviner of divinations, nor one who takes omens, nor one who reads signs, nor a sorcerer,
translations.11: nor a reciter of incantations, nor one who consults a conjurer or a soothsayer, nor one who seeks answers from the dead.
translations.12: For God abhors all who do these abominations, and it is on account of them that He is cutting them off from before you.
translations.13: But be simple toward God your Lord.
translations.14: For these nations whom you are to dispossess — it is to those who take omens and to diviners that they listen; but as for you, God your Lord has not permitted you anything like that.
translations.15: Rather, any prophet from among you, from some of your brothers, like me — God your Lord shall appoint him for you; from him you shall accept.
translations.16: In accordance with all that you asked of God your Lord at Mount Horeb, on the day of the assembly, when you said: 'I will no longer hear the voice of God my Lord, nor will I see this great fire, lest I die.'
translations.17: And God said to me: 'They have done well in all that they have said.'
translations.18: 'And whatever prophet I appoint for them, from some of their brothers like you — I shall teach him My word, and he shall address them with all that I command him.'
translations.19: 'And whatever person does not accept My word which he conveys on My behalf — I shall call him to account.'
translations.20: 'But whatever false prophet has been brazen and has fabricated a saying on My behalf — what I have not commanded him to say — and whoever prophesies in the name of other objects of worship: that false prophet shall be put to death.'
translations.21: And if you say to yourself: 'How shall we know the saying which God has not spoken?'
translations.22: Then: that which the false prophet speaks in the name of God, if that saying neither comes to pass nor proves necessary — it is the saying which God has not spoken; the false prophet has said it out of brazenness. Do not be wary of him.
